cl_f_L_per_hr.note: Approximate steady-state apparent oral clearance for lorlatinib; clearance increases with repeat dosing due to autoinduction.

t_half_hr.note: Approximate elimination half-life after repeated dosing.

tau_hr.note: Planned doses are oral, once daily.

fu.note: Lorlatinib is approximately 66% plasma protein bound.

ic50_nM.note: Approximate cellular IC50 for wild-type ALK; potency varies by assay and ALK mutation.

mw.note: Molecular weight of lorlatinib, in g/mol.
